text:
Predicates:
Star(x) ::: x is a star.
Striker(x) ::: x is a striker.
Player(x) ::: x is a soccer player.
Left(x, y) ::: x left team y.
Team(x) ::: x is a team.
Premises:
Striker(x) → Player(x) ::: Strikers are soccer players.
Left(RobertLewandowski, BayernMunich) ::: Robert Lewandowski left Bayern Munchen.
Left(x, y) → ¬PlaysFor(x, y) ::: If a player left a team, they no longer play for that team.
Conclusion:
Star(RobertLewandowski) ::: Robert Lewandowski is a star.
